reason: The analyst ran only a bivariate OLS on a trimmed sample and omitted the pre-period controls, including lagged productivity. That estimate (2.16) is about four times my adjusted estimate (about 0.58, CI roughly 0.12 to 1.04), so it is mostly confounding. The 'positive effect' direction survives adjustment, but the reported magnitude is not supported, and the report states no selection-on-observables caveat.
